Supreme Court to hear plea on waqf suits rejected for court fee non-payment

The Supreme Court will hear a plea challenging a Gujarat High Court order that upheld the rejection of waqf suits. The suits were dismissed due to non-payment of court fees. The plea seeks to overturn the High Court's decision.
